title: commicarpus pilosus
intro: Commicarpus pilosus, commonly known as the hairy calotrope, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a type of shrub that belongs to the Nyctaginaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of Commicarpus pilosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
